summary: A mixed legal and business day dominated by Reliance's debt fundraise plans and retail sector growth targets, alongside a Supreme Court governance case and tech sector regulatory developments.

bullets.text: Reliance Industries eyes Rs 10,000 crore debt fundraise to fund expansion and strategic initiatives.
Swiss Beauty Select projects 100%+ growth, targeting Rs 100 crore revenue by FY26-27 as premium beauty arm.
Decathlon opens first northeast store in Guwahati, targets Rs 1,000 crore running sports business in 4 years.
Law student moves Supreme Court alleging UP government misled court; no action taken against Executive Magistrate who issued CJP protest notice.
US 6th Circuit Court rules states can regulate prediction markets; Kalshi's sports event contracts not exclusively federal CFTC jurisdiction.
